meta.title: Side by Side
meta.description: Volunteers who walk alongside you through the paperwork.

topBar.label: Quick support
topBar.chatSoon: Online chat is coming soon. For now, you can start with our short form.

hero.title: You don't have to face the bureaucracy alone
hero.subtitle: We connect people living with mental health challenges with volunteers who sit with you to organize paperwork, prepare benefit applications together, and come along to committee meetings. Free, at your pace, and without power of attorney.
hero.ctaHelpHint: A short form, about one minute
hero.ctaVolunteerHint: A few hours, side by side

steps.title: How it works
steps.intro: Three simple steps. No rush, no pressure.

one.title: Tell us what you need
one.body: It takes about one minute, with simple choices.

two.title: We match you with a friendly volunteer
two.body: Someone with the time to sit beside you.

three.title: You tackle the paperwork together
three.body: Side by side, at your pace. You stay in charge.

footer.note: Volunteers offer practical and emotional support. They are not lawyers and do not act on your behalf.

pages.stub: This page is on its way. Thank you for your patience.

exitDialog.title: Leave the form?
exitDialog.body: Your answers won't be saved. You're welcome to come back any time.

support.title: What would you like help with?
support.hint: Choose as many as you like.

documents.title: Organizing documents
documents.body: Sorting letters and mail, getting medical summaries from your health portal, scanning and preparing files.

rights.title: Understanding your rights
rights.body: Going over benefits you may be entitled to, in plain language, and making a checklist of documents.

co_typing.title: Filling in forms together
co_typing.body: You say the answers and your volunteer types. You log in and press Send yourself.

scheduling.title: Booking appointments
scheduling.body: Setting up appointments with doctors, clinics, social services or government offices.

calls.title: Help during phone calls
calls.body: You call and confirm your identity, then switch to speaker so your volunteer can help.

accompaniment.title: Coming with you to a committee
accompaniment.body: Someone by your side on the day: waiting together, taking notes, reminding you what you wanted to say.

follow_up.title: Gentle reminders
follow_up.body: Short, kind messages about next steps, and checking on your case together.

meeting.title: How would you like to meet your volunteer?

city.title: Where would you like to meet?
city.hint: A city or area is enough.
city.label: City or area

note.title: Anything you'd like your volunteer to know?
note.label: Your note
note.warning: Please don't write medical details or diagnoses here.

details.title: How can we reach you?
details.hint: Only the volunteer who takes your request will see your full name and phone number.
details.phoneHint: A volunteer will call you on this number.
details.emailHint: So we can send you updates.

agree.title: One last thing
agree.body: Our volunteers are kind people who support you side by side. They are not lawyers and do not act on your behalf. You stay in charge of every decision.
agree.checkbox: I understand that volunteers support me but don't act on my behalf.

done.title: We received your request
done.body: Thank you for reaching out. A volunteer will call you soon to say hello and plan the next step together.

errors.supportRequired: Please choose at least one kind of help.
errors.cityRequired: Please tell us a city or area.
errors.noteTooLong: Please keep the note under 500 characters.
errors.phoneInvalid: This doesn't look like an Israeli phone number. For example: 052-123-4567.
errors.emailInvalid: This email address doesn't look complete.
errors.tooLong: This is a bit too long.
errors.scopeRequired: Please tick the box to continue.
errors.sendFailed: Something went wrong on our side and your request wasn't sent. Your answers are still here, please try again.
errors.unavailable: We can't receive requests right now. Please try again a little later.
